name: huge_pages
description: Controls whether PostgreSQL uses huge pages for its shared memory segment on Linux or Windows.
symptoms: higher CPU usage in memory management
shared memory allocation failure when 'on' but system huge pages are unavailable
unnecessary kernel memory fragmentation when misconfigured

constraints.hard_rule: value == 'on' implies system has sufficient huge pages configured (vm.nr_hugepages >= ceil(shared_buffers / hugepage_size))

tuning_tips: Start with default 'try'; only set to 'on' after verifying adequate huge pages are reserved in the OS and validating performance gain; avoid 'on' in containerized or shared environments without guaranteed huge page availability.
